title: Authentication & Identity
description: Implement authentication, authorization, roles, claims, and policies with ASP.NET Core Identity.
longDescription: This module covers ASP.NET Core Identity for managing users, authentication, and authorization. You will learn how to set up Identity, work with claims and roles, implement policies, add custom user properties, and integrate external login providers like Google.
whatYouLearn: Set up and configure ASP.NET Core Identity
Implement user registration, login, and logout
Use cookie authentication for persistent sessions
Work with claims and roles for fine-grained authorization
Add custom properties to the Identity user model
Integrate external login providers like Google
Manage username, email, and password policies
Perform CRUD operations on Identity users
